**As a Software Designer C\#/C\+\+/JAVA, you develop software for high\-tech products and machines.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Your software expertise plays an essential role in bringing these high\-tech solutions to life.
**What excites you as a Software Designer (C\#, C\+\+, Java)?**
---------------------------------------------------------------


As a Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high\-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.


From our office in Delft and at our clients' premises you work on challenging projects that take technology to the next level. You are the expert who designs, develops, and tests, but also likes to think along, connect, and contribute to team results.


* Translating customer and system requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
* Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
* Taking responsibility for a module/subsystem throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
* Ensuring software quality, scalability and maintainability through sound engineering practices.
* Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of engineers, helping them grow and deliver high\-quality results.


Sounds good? We’d love to tell you more…

  

**This is what you bring to the table**
---------------------------------------


* You have a technical Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
* You have 7\+ years of experience in technical software development, gained in various roles and across diverse product environments and/or projects.
* Over the past 4–5 years, you have worked within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical, or Analytical.
* You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages: C\#, C\+\+, or Java.
* You have knowledge of and/or experience with various development methodologies and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, and Agile, and you keep your technical expertise up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can apply these developments in practice as well.
* Based on your experience, you are able to coach junior engineers.
* You are a team player and keep the common goal in mind.
* You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
* You hold a valid European driver’s license and are willing to travel.
**This is what you can expect in return from Sioux**
----------------------------------------------------


* Flexible 32\-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
* A healthy work\-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
* You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
* By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high\-tech projects.
* You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
* Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
* We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from events together with your partner and family, summer barbecues, innovative knowledge sessions to tasty lunches and after work drinks.
* You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen.
**High Tech \& High Fun**
-------------------------


We can tell you all about the typical Sioux\-culture and the high\-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

* Bouwen van schaalbare en onderhoudbare software.
* Meedenken over architectuur en technische verbeteringen.
* Samenwerken binnen Agile\-teams en kennis delen met andere developers.

jobs.description:
**Base Location:** Flexible Scotland \| We're proud to offer a Flexible First approach to work, and this role is no exception. We will, however, need your base 'home' location to be within travelling distance to our Inverness or Elgin sites as you will spend the majority of your time working in Substations and on Projects in Inverness\-shire.

**Salary:** £50,964 \- £85,880 \+ overtime \+ standby \+ car/car allowance and a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible working options available


**The role**



As a Protection Field Engineer at SSEN Transmission, you'll be instrumental in achieving Net Zero. This hands\-on role is key to expanding and updating our network, directly ensuring the exceptional reliability and resilience of our transmission system for all users.


**You will**


* Ensure the Transmission network operates to the highest reliability standards through technical management of connected protection and control systems.
* Help deliver the multi\-million\-pound capital delivery programme on our transmission network, including the commissioning of new protection assets.
* Support all aspects of field protection work, including commissioning, maintenance, outage management, contractor liaison and budget management.
* At times, you may be required to work away from your base location due to the diverse nature, and sometime remote locations, of our plant and equipment.
* Participate in a paid out of hours standby rota due to the 24/7/365 nature of operating a high voltage Transmission network.


**You have**


* A qualification in a relevant electrical engineering subject (a minimum of HNC level with a recognised apprenticeship or suitable relevant experience being desirable).
* Previous experience and technical knowledge of power systems protection, including installation and commissioning of high voltage plant and apparatus up to 400kV.
* Strong understanding of reading and interpreting protection single line, schematic and block diagrams.
* Experience of carrying out testing and fault\-finding on secondary wiring and auxiliary equipment, including the application of logic and settings files on Protection intelligent electronic devices.
* Existing Senior Authorised Person (SAP) or High Voltage Switching authorisations at Transmission voltages up to 400kV, are highly advantageous for this role or if working towards this.


**A full UK driving license is required as this role will require travelling to our various locations.**



Please note: Applications will also be considered from electrical engineers from other sectors with less specific protection experience, with a starting salary commensurate with experience levels. Training and development will be provided to ensure continuous progress.

  



**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Andy on andrew.torrance@sse.com / 01738 275370 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.description:
*Har du solid erfaring med C\#, .NET og udvikling af integrationer i Azure? Kan du omsætte tekniske krav og arkitekturprincipper til robust kode, veldesignede API’er og løsninger, der fungerer stabilt i drift? Så kan du blive vores nye kollega.*


Du får en central teknisk rolle i udviklingen af Roskilde Universitets Azure\-baserede integrationsplatform. Du skal udvikle integrationer og fælles komponenter samt bidrage til en robust og sammenhængende applikations\- og integrationsarkitektur. Samtidig får du mulighed for at fastlægge teamets standarder for kode, unittest og dokumentation inden for vores fælles arkitekturprincipper og i dialog med teamet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med teamets øvrige udviklere, faglig koordinator og testmanager samt med arkitekter, drift og projektledere.


Roskilde Universitet er i gang med en omfattende digital modernisering. Vi udskifter og opgraderer centrale systemer og flytter løbende integrationer til en fælles integrationsplatform. Det stiller krav til robuste API’er, genanvendelige komponenter, sikker dataudveksling og løsninger, der kan overvåges, driftes og videreudvikles.


**Om Digital og dit team**  

Du bliver en del af Digitaliseringsenheden med 16 medarbejdere. Enheden hører under Digital, Roskilde Universitets centrale afdeling for IT, digitalisering, informationssikkerhed, samt projekt\- og procesmetoder. Digital har ca. 70 medarbejdere.


Din daglige base bliver udviklingsteamet, som består af fem udviklere, en fagkoordinator samt en testmanager. Teamet deltager i udviklingsprojekter og varetager samtidig den løbende vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af universitetets systemer, integrationer og platforme.


**Arbejdsopgaver**  

Dine hovedopgaver i jobbet er at:


* Udvikle og vedligeholde integrationer, fælles komponenter og referenceimplementeringer på vores integrationsplatform.
* Omsætte behov, krav og arkitekturprincipper til tekniske designs og robuste løsninger samt videreudvikle principperne for udviklingsområdet i samarbejde med teamet og arkitekterne.

* **AI Security Testing:** Design and execute AI\-specific security and safety assessments for LLM, RAG, and agentic applications, covering threats such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive\-data disclosure, insecure output handling, excessive agency, tool misuse, and cross\-tenant data exposure. * **Security Findings, Remediation \& Reporting:** Document vulnerabilities and control gaps with clear risk, impact, evidence, and remediation guidance. Work with delivery teams to track and validate fixes, communicate residual risk to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and report assurance metrics, recurring findings, and risk trends.
* **Security Automation \& Release Assurance:** Integrate automated AI security and evaluation tests into CI/CD pipelines and release processes. Define security regression checks, release gates, and acceptance criteria to identify material risks before production deployment.

**Software Test Automation****:**


* **Test Automation:** Build and maintain automated functional, regression, API, and end\-to\-end tests using suitable frameworks such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, or Postman.
* **Defect Investigation:** Reproduce issues, trace application and cloud logs, isolate root causes, and provide actionable defect reports to engineering teams.
* **Quality Enablement:** Promote pragmatic testing practices, reusable test assets, and shared ownership of quality across product and engineering teams.
**Requirements**

* **AI Security Knowledge:** Practical understanding of security and safety risks affecting LLM, RAG, and agentic applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool use, excessive permissions, insecure output handling, and model or application abuse.

jobs.description:
Cloud-native applicaties draaien steeds vaker op Kubernetes, maar het beheer van identiteiten is nog lang niet altijd geautomatiseerd. In deze opdracht ontwikkel je een Kubernetes operator die identiteiten zoals OIDC-clients, gebruikers en groepen beheert over meerdere identity providers. Je onderzoekt hoe je provisioning, credentialbeheer en multitenancy standaardiseert in één provider-onafhankelijke oplossing.

Binnen het LMS-platform maken verschillende diensten gebruik van externe identity providers (IdP’s) zoals Entra ID, Keycloak of Okta voor authenticatie en autorisatie. Hiervoor zijn identity resources nodig, zoals OIDC clients, gebruikers en groepen.

Het beheren van deze resources gebeurt vaak handmatig of via provider-specifieke oplossingen. Dit maakt het proces foutgevoelig, moeilijk schaalbaar en lastig herbruikbaar tussen verschillende diensten en omgevingen.

Er is behoefte aan een uniforme en geautomatiseerde aanpak waarbij identity provisioning gestandaardiseerd wordt en onderdeel wordt van het platform.

Deze afstudeeropdracht maakt deel uit van het project ‘Operation: Human Intelligence‘. In dit project bouw je samen met andere IT-studenten aan het leerplatform van de toekomst: open source, Europees en AI-assisted. Zo help je deelnemers écht verder met een platform dat zich aanpast aan verschillende manieren van leren.

De opdracht

Je onderzoekt hoe identity provisioning gestandaardiseerd en geautomatiseerd kan worden binnen het LMS-platform, en hoe dit vertaald kan worden naar een Kubernetes-native oplossing.

Je opdracht bestaat uit de volgende onderdelen:

Onderzoek de verschillende typen identiteiten (zoals OIDC clients, gebruikers en groepen) binnen identity providers zoals Entra ID, Keycloak en Okta. Bepaal welke configuraties en metadata essentieel zijn.
Analyseer de verschillen en overeenkomsten tussen deze providers en bepaal welke onderdelen generiek te modelleren zijn.
Ontwerp een provider-onafhankelijk schema waarin identity resources eenduidig beschreven kunnen worden. Dit schema moet geschikt zijn voor gebruik in een cloud-native omgeving en toepasbaar zijn voor verschillende diensten binnen het LMS.
Vertaal dit ontwerp naar Kubernetes door:
het definiëren van Custom Resource Definitions (CRD’s);
het uitwerken van hoe reconciliation en state management plaatsvindt.

Ontwikkel vervolgens een Kubernetes operator die:
de gedefinieerde resources interpreteert;
identity resources automatisch aanmaakt, bijwerkt en verwijdert in één of meerdere identity providers;
de gewenste en actuele situatie consistent houdt.

Besteed hierbij specifiek aandacht aan:
veilige opslag en rotatie van secrets en credentials;
ondersteuning van multi-tenancy;
robuust en idempotent gedrag van de operator;
foutafhandeling en observability.

Valideer de oplossing door middel van een Proof of Concept, waarbij je minimaal twee identity providers integreert binnen een (gesimuleerde) LMS-omgeving.

Over Info Support

Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst.

De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan.

Visual Studio Code is where millions of developers turn ideas into working software. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in Zurich to tackle hard product and platform challenges as VS Code and GitHub Copilot continue to reshape how developers build software.

You will help to evolve VS Code as a market leading developer environment, seamlessly connecting its editor, agentic coding abilities, platform and extension ecosystem. You will identify where investment matters, prove difficult ideas in code, and establish approaches that multiple teams can build on. This is hands-on technical leadership: the opportunity to change both what developers can accomplish and what our engineering teams can deliver.

About The Team

We work in the open, with direct feedback from developers and extension authors. You will partner with engineers, designers, researchers, and product leaders across our team, GitHub, and Microsoft. Performance, accessibility, extensibility, security, and developer control are part of the product, not finishing touches.

Address architectural bottlenecks in large workspaces, proving an approach in code that multiple feature teams can adopt.
Define extension or workspace APIs that unlock new capabilities while preserving compatibility with existing extensions and remote development environments.
Prototype how developers delegate, review, and validate work with Copilot, then establish the product and platform boundaries needed to ship it.
Reshape and support our engineering process with custom solutions fine-tuned for throughput and quality.
